title: Juicy Roasted Vietnamese Pork Com Tam
description: A spicy and energizing Vietnamese dish featuring caramelized pork, roast vegetables, and a flexitarian friendly twist, served with com tam.

ingredients.name: roast vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, green beans, and bell peppers

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, brown sugar, grated ginger, garlic, and chili flakes.
Add the pork shoulder to the bowl and coat with the marinade.
Let the pork marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Place the pork on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 20 minutes per pound.
While the pork is roasting, toss the roast vegetables with lime juice and season with salt and pepper.
Spread the vegetables on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
Slice the pork into thin strips and serve with com tam, roast vegetables, and garnished with cilantro.
